summary: Caledonia Mining filed a Form 6-K attaching its press release of November 12, 2026, reporting abridged, unaudited third-quarter and nine-month results for the period ended September 30, 2026. Revenue rose 10.5% to US$78.9m on an average realised gold price of US$4,134/oz, though profit after tax fell 39.3% to US$11.3m on a US$12.9m non-cash derivative fair-value loss tied to January 2026 convertible senior notes and gold put options. The Board approved a quarterly dividend of US$0.14 per share. No transaction or special-situation event; ordinary earnings disclosure and conference-call notice.
